## Scope

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the smallest relevant tests and recorded the result.
- [ ] Installation, runtime, or UI claims are backed by a reproducible command.
- [ ] Generated outputs, caches, raw structures, databases, models, and private files remain outside the public tree.

## Scientific and contract boundaries

- [ ] This change does not turn heuristic candidates into validated binding, druggability, discovery, clinical, or superiority claims.
- [ ] Static canonical ranking remains separate from evaluator, ligand, alignment, and motion evidence.
- [ ] Any resource, denominator, threshold, or formula change has a new versioned contract and explicit evidence.
- [ ] NMA/motion and ML remain experimental unless their independent gates are documented.

## Documentation and release hygiene

- [ ] README, changelog, or relevant public specification is updated when behavior or support expectations changed.
- [ ] Public-hygiene and version checks pass, or the failure is explicitly explained.
- [ ] No release, tag, force-push, or external publication is implied by this pull request.
